title: File:University Square, Edgbaston campus, The University of Birmingham - geograph.org.uk - 28004.jpg
author: Jim Champion
description: University Square, Edgbaston campus, The University of Birmingham. Trees in the central university square on a sunny summer's morning. The lack of students is not due to  the early hour, but to the fact that they are on their summer vacation. The grounds are always looking their best just before the week of summer graduation ceremonies.
